title: BIS Hallmarking System — Complete Guide
text: BIS Hallmarking System in India. Mandatory hallmarking of gold jewellery introduced in phases: Phase 1 (June 2021): 256 districts. Phase 2 (Aug 2021): 400 more districts. Now mandatory across India for 14K/18K/20K/22K/23K/24K gold jewellery. The 3-mark system: 1. BIS Logo (triangle shape) 2. Purity code (e.g., 916 for 22K, 750 for 18K, 585 for 14K) 3. HUID — 6-character alphanumeric Hallmark Unique ID (since April 2022, replaces old AHC logo and year mark). HUID verification: Via BIS Care app, portal, or helpline 1800-11-4000. Purity grades: 24K = 999, 23K = 958, 22K = 916, 21K = 875, 18K = 750, 14K = 585, 9K = 375. Silver hallmarking: Voluntary (BIS recommends S999, S970, S925, S800).
